title: In dit dorp gaat iedereen op vakantie... behalve wij
style: 3D game render of blocky toy-like avatars from an online sandbox game: cube-shaped heads, rectangular arms and legs, smooth glossy plastic shading, simple cartoon painted faces, bright saturated colors, small sunny village built from blocks, game screenshot look, no logos, no watermarks, no text

daan.name: Daan
daan.look: boy avatar wearing a backwards red cap, white t-shirt, blue jeans, holding a smartphone

jayden.name: Jayden
jayden.look: boy avatar with curly dark hair, oversized grey hoodie, nervous face with sweat drops

oma.name: Oma
oma.look: old lady avatar with grey bun hairstyle, round glasses, flowery dress, big pink sunglasses and a sun hat

shots.scene: Wide shot of a tiny blocky village street, every neighbour walks out of their house rolling a suitcase toward a bus marked with a palm tree icon, sunny morning.
shots.motion: neighbours roll suitcases along the street and wave happily, camera slowly pans

lines.text: In dit dorp gaat iedereen op vakantie...

shots.caption:
IN DIT DORP GAAT
IEDEREEN OP VAKANTIE

shots.scene: Inside a small blocky living room, Daan and Jayden sit on a saggy couch staring at a laptop, rain-grey light, empty pizza box.
shots.motion: both slowly turn their heads to the camera with blank faces
shots.caption: BEHALVE WIJ

shots.scene: Close-up of Jayden clicking a big green Book button on the laptop, a red error pop-up appears, he is sweating.
shots.motion: Jayden clicks, freezes and sweats as the error appears
shots.caption: BETALING MISLUKT

shots.scene: Both friends hammer the laptop keyboard and mouse at full speed in rhythm, papers flying, dramatic low angle, light flashing on every click.
shots.motion: both slam the keys in rhythm on every beat, camera shakes on each click
shots.caption: BOEK BOEK BOEK

shots.scene: Oma looks out of a blocky airplane window high in the clouds, wearing big pink sunglasses, waving down at the camera.
shots.motion: Oma waves cheerfully from the plane window and talks

lines.text: Doei jongens! Ik stuur wel een kaartje!

shots.caption: zelfs oma

shots.scene: Close-up of Daan staring at his phone in shock, jaw dropped, the screen shows a big red SOLD OUT label.
shots.motion: Daan refreshes his phone and his jaw drops in shock
shots.caption: UITVERKOCHT

shots.scene: Daan and Jayden sit in a tiny inflatable kiddie pool in a grey blocky backyard, wearing sunglasses and holding drinks with umbrellas, a garden hose sprays like a fountain.
shots.motion: both lean back relaxed in the kiddie pool, water splashes gently

lines.text: Nou. Ibiza is ook maar water.

shots.caption:
IBIZA
(achtertuin editie)
